title: Good idea, not well made
text: Good idea, not well made. I like the idea of this but after I get the hats on the clips, they have trouble staying on the cord. I finally just gave up. I used it in the closet and maybe over the door might be better but I in the closet, the clips and hats and everything, just kept falling down...which was highly annoying

product_metadata.title: Perfect Curve Cap Rack Pro System – Hat Rack for Baseball Caps | Over Door Organizer | Baseball Cap Organizer |Hat Hangers for Closet |Hat Organizer for Wall | 10 Clips Hold up to 30 caps | White
features: SAVE SPACE: Keep your closets clean and clutter-free with the Perfect Curve Cap Rack System. Hook over a door, mount on a wall or hang over a closet rod to safely store your favorite caps. All hardware included. Simple assembly required.

HOLDS UP TO 30 CAPS: Each CapRack Pro System comes with 10 CapClips. Each CapClip can hold up to three (3) baseball caps at the same time (see video below). This allows for 10 caps to be “displayed” while at the same time allowing another 20 caps to be “stored” (see video below).

CAPS FACE FORWARD: Unlike other cap racks, our CapClips “hold” your cap from under the crown so that the front logo is visible. It also supports the cap – rather than the cap just hanging – so that the cap keeps its shape.

EACH CLIP IS ADJUSTABLE: Move each CapClip up or down the sturdy 5-foot round cord to create a custom display. For example, space the top four CapClips far apart at the top of the cord to highlight your most important caps, while placing the remaining CapClips closer together near the bottom to store your “less important” caps.

HANG OVER A DOOR, IN THE CLOSET AND MORE: Place the Cap Rack System almost anywhere in your house, dorm or wherever you keep your cap collection. It comes with an over-the-door hook that fits doors 1.375” thick. Also place on a wall or from the ceiling like a mobile.
